description: Summarise this LetsBot workspace's account in one call: (1) subscription — current plan, billing period, start and end/renewal date, status, whether it renews automatically and the next automatic charge, trial state and days left, any temporary plan boost, the line items and the add-ons/features included; (2) usage — messages sent in the rolling last 30 days against the plan's monthly message limit (the same figure as the panel dashboard), AI replies used against the AI allowance, team seats used against the plan's seat limit, and the number of contacts; (3) channels — every WhatsApp number (official Cloud API or QR) with its connection state, plus Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, e-mail inboxes and, where the workspace has them, the website chat widget, Viber/LINE/WeChat and SMS. Use it when the user asks what plan they are on, when it renews or expires, what is included, how much of their quota is left, or which channels are connected. Each section carries a `where_to_manage` hint (panel page and link) for changes. Read-only: it changes nothing, sends nothing to anyone, does NOT renew, upgrade, cancel, change billing, or connect/disconnect anything, and it does not contact Meta or any other outside service, so a WhatsApp number's connection state is the last state LetsBot recorded. It returns no passwords, access tokens, API keys, webhook secrets or card/bank details — only plan, usage and channel names, numbers and states. Prices are in minor units (cents). A section that could not be read comes back as null with a note.
name: get_account_overview
